item.title: Process Injection - AV Evasion
item.description: In the previous posts, we have explored various techniques for process injection, such as using VirtualAllocEx and CreateRemoteThread. However, these methods often require write and execute permissions on the target process, which can trigger antivirus (AV) detection. In this article, we will create shellcode using the Process Injection technique combined with XOR encryption to obfuscate the code and evade antivirus detection. By encrypting our shellcode, we can make it less recognizable to AV software, which often relies on signature-based detection methods.
